# TickerBoard

**Class:** `UltraCanvasTickerBoard` · **Group:** [Text, images and media](../Groups/Text-images-and-media.md) · **Header:** [`UltraCanvas/include/Plugins/Diagrams/UltraCanvasTickerBoard.h`](../../../UltraCanvas/include/Plugins/Diagrams/UltraCanvasTickerBoard.h) · `#include "Plugins/Diagrams/UltraCanvasTickerBoard.h"`

**Inherits:** [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md) → `Element`

## What it is for

Text that scrolls past by itself (a marquee, a news crawl, a stock ticker, an LED sign)

## Guides and examples

The component documentation with explained, compiled C++ examples:

- [UltraCanvasTickerBoard](../../UltraCanvas/UltraCanvasTickerBoard.md)

## Creating it

Factory functions (the usual way - every element is held in a `std::shared_ptr`):

```cpp
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasTickerBoard> CreateTickerBoard( const std::string& identifier, float x, float y, float w, float h, TickerBoardFace face = TickerBoardFace::Text);
```

Constructors:

```cpp
UltraCanvasTickerBoard(const std::string& identifier, float x, float y, float w, float h);
```

The first string argument is always the element's **identifier**, never its text (see [Core concepts](../Core-Concepts.md#identifiers)).

## Callbacks

Assign a lambda to the member (or call the setter). Capture the element and its parents **raw**, never as a `shared_ptr` - see [Events and callbacks](../Events-and-Callbacks.md#ownership).

| Callback | Signature | When it fires |
|---|---|---|
| `onItemClick` | `std::function<void(size_t index)> onItemClick` | left button released on an item |
| `onItemHover` | `std::function<void(size_t index)> onItemHover` | The item under the pointer changed; SIZE_MAX when it left every item. |

**Inherited callbacks:**

- from [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md): `eventCallback`, `onPopupAboutToClose`, `onPopupClosed`, `onPopupOpened`, `SetEventCallback`

## Option types in this header

### enum `TickerBoardFace`

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `Text` | the strip set in a font (fontFamily, fontSize) on a plain band |
| `DotMatrix` | the strip lit on a grid of round LED dots, 7 rows high, |

### enum `TickerDirection`

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `Leftward` | the usual crawl: items enter at the right and leave at the left |
| `Rightward` |  |

### enum `TickerTrend`

Colours the change field (and picks its arrow): upColor, downColor or flatColor from the style.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `Flat` |  |
| `Up` |  |
| `Down` |  |
